jobs.title: Front-End Engineer
description: Led front-end architecture design and refactoring centered on Vue + TypeScript for merchant back-office systems, online ordering, and QR code ordering systems, increasing system stability by 50% and reducing long-term maintenance costs by 50%.
Collaborated closely with 6–8 member cross-functional teams (PM, Design, Backend) to define front-end technical roadmaps and architectural standards, ensuring project scalability and consistency.
Established a cross-product UI Component Library covering 80% of design requirements, shortening new feature development cycles by 50% and significantly improving product iteration efficiency.
Introduced Trunk Based Development and Feature Toggle workflows to optimize version control and release strategies, supporting high-frequency requirement changes.
Spearheaded the migration of products to a Monorepo architecture, integrating shared modules and reducing cross-project maintenance costs.
Built a comprehensive CI/CD automated deployment process, increasing deployment success rates and reducing manual operational risks.
Established and implemented Code Review and engineering standards to enhance team code quality and technical culture.

jobs.title: Front-End Engineer
description: Responsible for front-end architecture development and performance optimization of core social products, ensuring stable system operation in high-traffic environments.
Utilized core-js and Babel to resolve cross-browser compatibility issues and support legacy browsers, improving overall user coverage and system stability.
Deeply investigated and resolved Nuxt.js SSR memory leak issues, eliminating frequent service restarts and significantly improving system stability and efficiency.
Implemented highly interactive stock K-line and trend analysis charts using ECharts, optimizing data rendering performance for a smooth visualization experience.
Integrated LINE LIFF and LINE BOT investment assistant systems to create a seamless interaction flow between social platforms and messaging software.
Collaborated on the design and development of LINE BOT investment assistant features, enhancing real-time push notifications and engagement to increase user retention and platform activity.
